thread:
maya: Quick design check — the 'priority pin' affordance in the rules list feels hidden when the list is compact. Users don't notice they can pin a rule to the top.
sam: Agreed. Maybe add a subtle label 'pin to top' on hover + a keyboard shortcut? e.g., `Shift+P`
jordan: I like the hover label, but keyboard shortcut needs discoverability. We could add it to the rule context menu and the tooltip.
devin: Also the preview simulator toggle disappears when you collapse the rule details. Found myself hunting for it. Can we keep a sticky mini-preview control in the header? @maya
maya: Good point — sticky mini-preview sounds right. Should be small: play/pause + last-run status.
aria: Accessibility nit: the pin control is a pure icon with no accessible name when compacted. Screen readers read it as "button". Need `aria-label="Pin rule to top"`.
jordan: +1 on aria-labels. Also keyboard focus order is weird: hitting tab lands inside the rule body before the pin. Pin should be focusable earlier.
sam: Validation language quibble: when two rules conflict we show "Rule conflict". Could we be more actionable: "Rule conflict — check priorities or pin one rule to resolve"?
maya: Yes, make error copy prescriptive. Also show a one-line hint with a link to an explain doc. e.g., "Priorities determine execution order — learn more"
devin: UX question: when simulating, should the simulator run against the current unpublished draft or the last published snapshot? Right now it's mixed and confuses PMs.
aria: Strong vote for "simulate draft" by default, with a dropdown to switch to last published. That matches intent when editing.
sam: Implementation note: if simulate draft is default we need to snapshot draft params for reproducible runs. Could be expensive — maybe warn if inputs > 50 rules.
jordan: Performance note — simulator UI should show a small spinner and "estimating time" if we detect > 200 rules. Don't block main thread.
maya: Microcopy for the preview header: change "Run simulation" -> "Simulate routing (draft)" when on draft. Keeps clarity.
devin: Visual: when a rule is pinned, add a soft divider and a faint badge "Pinned" not just an icon. Helps scan.
aria: Color contrast for the pinned badge currently fails AA at small sizes. Use a darker background or bolder text.
sam: Minor: preview results table truncates the 'reason' column awkwardly. Make it wrap or allow expand-on-click.
maya: Overall consensus: sticky mini-preview, better pin visibility (icon + badge + aria-label), improved validation copy with a link, default simulate draft, and accessible focus order.
jordan: I'll update the Figma prototypes and send a new link. Expect frames by EOD.
design-ci-bot: Design file updated: https://figma.com/file/abc123/routing-policy-v2 — frames: 12-16 (maya/jordan).
maya: Thanks! Quick follow-up: can someone QA keyboard-only flow after the prototype? Devin?
devin: Yep, I'll run a keyboard/a11y pass tomorrow and post findings here.
sam: Filing a tiny ticket for copy tweaks + aria fix. I'll link it once created. :thumbsup:
maya: Perfect — thanks team.
